Zilean

Mid Sleeper

Double-Bomb AP Mid Zilean

How to play this build

Rewind (E) lets you drop two Time Bombs back to back: the first stuns, the second bursts hard. Poke with that combo and speed allies with W. The ult (Chronoshift) revives your carry mid-fight: it swings teamfights.

Skill order

Max priority:

Q Bomba de Tiempo → W Rebobinar → E Distorsión Temporal

The ultimate (R) is always leveled at 6, 11 and 16.

Level 123456789101112131415161718
Q QQQQQ
W WWWWW
E EEEEE
R RRR
Why this order
Time Bomb (Q) for damage and the stun; Rewind (W) second to lower the cooldown and drop a double bomb. E (slow) at 1 point.

Items and what they do

  1. Deathfire Grasp The classic burst item: AP + active that deals % target-health damage and amplifies your next hit. One-shots.
  2. Rabadon's Deathcap The biggest AP item in the game: multiplies your total AP.
  3. Rylai's Crystal Scepter AP and health; your spells slow enemies (helps land everything).
  4. Void Staff AP and % magic penetration; a must vs. enemies stacking MR.
  5. Sorcerer's Shoes Boots with magic penetration.

Masteries: how they work

In Season 3 you have up to 30 points (at level 30) to split across three trees: Offense (damage), Defense (durability) and Utility (mana, cooldown reduction and mobility). The notation 21/0/9 means 21 points in Offense, 0 in Defense and 9 in Utility.

Masteries
21/0/9 — Offense
Why this page
21/0/9 goes damage so the double bomb blows up squishies.
Runes
Magic pen, mana regen, AP quints
